root_cause_class: Catalog pins sit at local y = 0.012 mod 0.048 (on the M4 track in R0 at origin 0 mod 0.048). Mirroring about X maps y to H - y, so a macro is orientation-invariant only if H = 2*0.012 = 0.024 mod 0.048. The generator snaps H to the 0.270 row, so H mod 0.048 is arbitrary (0.006 to 0.042); 19 of 21 catalog abstracts are mirror-variant. Note that H a multiple of the pitch is NOT sufficient because the platform M4 offset is pitch/4.
